label: Order
caption: APPLE, INC. V. EPIC GAMES, INC.
text: UPON CONSIDERATION of the application of counsel for the applicant, IT IS ORDERED that further proceedings in the United States District Court for the Northern District of California, case No. 4:20-cv-5640, are hereby administratively stayed until 5 p.m. (EDT) on Thursday, August 13, 2026.
